item.title: Blocked drain on Marlpit Lane, 2nd November
item.description:
The drain on the outside wall of our house is blocked and when it rains the water can’t drain away fast enough. In the winter when the heavy rain is here this causes a huge issue and has caused our house to have a damp problem on the outside wall which we are now trying to deal with. The house was empty for 2 years before we bought it and the drain was completely ovegrown and we had to clear it out as best as we can so it definitely hasn’t been maintained in a few years. If this could please be looked at and cleared we would really appreciate it. Thank you!

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Marlpit Lane, Norton, Tewkesbury
